[Statistics Department](https://www.stat.ubc.ca/)

and teach in the

## Currently

- Courses in UBC Statistics and the MDS-Vancouver program

## Background

- Data Science Educator & Developer Advocate, Posit PBC (formerly RStudio)
- Instructor and lesson maintainer with [The Carpentries](https://carpentries.org/) since 2014
- Workshops on Python, R, git, and reproducible research
  at universities, conferences, and research groups
